# MacArthur-Rosenzwig {#sec-rosenzwig}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d N}{dt} & = r N (1 - \frac{N}{K}) - \frac{a N P}{1 + a h N} \\
    \frac{d P}{dt} & =  \frac{ \beta a N P}{1 + a h N} - d P
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-rosenzweig-macarthur}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Rosenzweig-MacArthur model showing stable fixed point"
#| label: fig-rosenzweig-macarthur-sim

library(deSolve)

# Function to define Rosenzweig-MacArthur ODE system
rosenzweig_macarthur <- function(t, state, parms) {
  N <- state["N"]
  P <- state["P"]

  r <- parms["r"]
  K <- parms["K"]
  a <- parms["a"]
  h <- parms["h"]
  beta <- parms["beta"]
  d <- parms["d"]

  dN_dt <- r * N * (1 - N / K) - (a * N * P) / (1 + a * h * N)
  dP_dt <- (beta * a * N * P) / (1 + a *h * N) - d * P

  list(c(dN_dt, dP_dt))
}

# Parameters for stable fixed point
parms <- c(
  r = 1.0,      # Prey growth rate
  K = 5.0,      # Prey carrying capacity
  a = 1.3,      # Predation rate
  h = 0.9,       # Handling time
  beta = 0.6,   # Conversion efficiency
  d = 0.5       # Predator death rate
)

# Initial conditions
state <- c(N = 5, P = 2)

# Time sequence
times <- seq(0, 200, by = 0.1)

# Solve ODE
solution <- ode(state, times, rosenzweig_macarthur, parms)

# Calculate equilibrium (fixed point)
# At equilibrium: dN/dt = 0 and dP/dt = 0
# P* = (r * kappa) / (a * (beta - 1)) * (1 - N*/K)
# N* such that dP/dt = 0
N_eq <- parms["d"] * parms["kappa"] / (parms["beta"] * parms["a"] - parms["d"])
P_eq <- parms["r"] * (1 - N_eq / parms["K"]) * (parms["kappa"] + N_eq) / parms["a"]

# Create two plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

# Plot 1: Time series
plot(solution[, "time"], solution[, "N"], type = "l",
     col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.7), lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size",
     main = "Time series")
lines(solution[, "time"], solution[, "P"],
      col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)
abline(h = N_eq, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3), lty = 2)
abline(h = P_eq, col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.3), lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Prey (N)", "Predator (P)"),
       col = c(rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.8), rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.8)),
       lwd = 2, cex = 0.85)

# Plot 2: Phase portrait (state-space diagram)
plot(solution[, "N"], solution[, "P"], type = "l",
     col = rgb(0, 0.7, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Prey (N)", ylab = "Predator (P)",
     main = "Phase portrait")

# Add fixed point
points(N_eq, P_eq, pch = 16, col = "red", cex = 1.5)
text(N_eq, P_eq, " Equilibrium", pos = 1, cex = 0.9, col = "red")

# Add starting point
points(state["N"], state["P"], pch = 16, col = "blue", cex = 1.2)
text(state["N"], state["P"], " Start", pos = 2, cex = 0.9)

# Add arrow showing direction
arrows(solution[1, "N"], solution[1, "P"],
       solution[100, "N"], solution[100, "P"],
       length = 0.1, col = rgb(0, 0.7, 0, 0.5), lwd = 1.5)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
